notes: Boot harl_a40 with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, with PinMAME's built-in motorcycle mechanism enabled (--handle-mechanics 1), so the scenario never writes 35 or 36. Insert three coins on the center slot (public 5) and press Start (54). Leave the served ball on the shooter lane switch 16 for 15 s, then press the Launch button 53 once while it is still there, and let it leave. Close the spinner 28 between steps so the ROM sees playfield activity. Hold a ball on the power scoop 46 for 15 s with no other switch closed, then pulse the motorcycle enter opto 37 twice with the scoop empty, and drain the ball.
